pages.lesson:
LESSON: LINEAR EQUATIONS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Algebra 2.1 Algebraic Expressions (6 Lessons) Factorizing, simplifying and evalu
Topic 2.2: Linear Equations

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Linear Equations. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we solve linear equations in two unknowns?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. form linear equations in two unknowns in real-life situations
2. solve linear equations in two unknowns by substitution method in real-life situations
3. solve linear equations in two unknowns by elimination method in real-life situations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Linear Equations.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Linear Equations using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Role-play activities such as shopping on two different items in the shop to form linear equations in two unknowns,
2. Discuss with others and use activities involving two unknowns,
3. Discuss and use substitution method to find the solutions of simultaneous equations in two unknowns,
4. Discuss and use elimination method to find the solutions of simultaneous equations in two unknowns,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we solve linear equations in two unknowns?
2. Where do we use linear equations in two unknowns in real-life situations?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Linear Equations is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
